desc:
💥 Untitled Ragdoll Game is a ragdoll physics sandbox game! Punch, grab and throw floppy dummies, then feed them to wild machines!

🚨 NEW: the Boxing Ring, a rebuilt Train Track with tunnels and slime, cannon targets, all-new sounds and full controller support!

⚙️ Feed dummies to 17 machines: Shredder, Hydraulic Press, Tesla Coil and more
🔫 Unlock 30+ weapons with your kills, from bats to miniguns
✋ Grab dummies with your empty hands and drag them with the grab beam
🤸 Watch real ragdoll physics send dummies tumbling
🦵 Knock arms, legs and heads clean off
🌐 Start your own custom server and set the rules

📱 Plays on phone, tablet, PC and console
👍 Like and favorite for new machines and weapons!
